anchors.paper_title: Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interfaces: Random Forests Vs Regularized Lda - Non-Linear Beats Linear
anchors.paper_venue: TUGraz OPEN Library (Graz University of Technology)
anchors.reason: Same authors re-analyse the RF-driven SMR BCI data with CSP features, but it is an offline method comparison, not the dataset's own data descriptor; the primary paper is the DOI 10.1007/s00500-012-0895-4 study.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 512 Hz sampling rate from 14 healthy subjects (age 20-30 years) using 15 active Ag/AgCl electrodes in a g.LADYbird cap (Guger Technologies OG) with Laplacian montage, left mastoid reference, and right mastoid ground. Recording was performed using g.USBamp hardware and BCI2000 software with 8th order Butterworth band-pass filtering (online) and 50 Hz line frequency notch filtering. Subjects performed cue-guided motor imagery of right hand or feet movements for 5-second trials within a single session containing 8 runs with continuous visual bar-graph feedback.
